name: GLM 4.7
description: GLM-4.7 is a powerful next-generation coding model that delivers major gains in multilingual agentic coding, terminal-based workflows, and tool use, with strong improvements across benchmarks like SWE-bench, Terminal Bench, and τ²-Bench. It also features enhanced reasoning and math performance, plus significantly upgraded UI generation—producing cleaner, more modern web pages and better-designed slides.
